text:
jamie: Seeing a spike of 503s from /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 since 12:02. Latency and errors concentrated on older dedicated nodes. I have a small hotfix artifact that pins the embed runtime to v2.3.1 which addresses a kv-cache eviction race. I want to bypass canary and do an expedited deploy to Dedicated eu pool. Requesting approval from ops + oncall.
rohan: How urgent is bypass vs short canary? can we do 5m canary first?
sasha: Telemetry: 95th latency up 2x, error rate concentrated on nodes running v2.2.7. New artifact tested locally, unit + integration smoke passed. Bypass ok if ops signs off.
jamie: Patch built from main @ commit abc123. Artifact path: gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/abc123.tar.gz. Release note draft: "Fix: kv-cache eviction race causing 503s under concurrency (embeddings)"
rohan: @deploybot can you run preflight and surface blockers?
deploybot: Preflight: smoke tests: PASS, canary-tests: SKIPPED (bypass request), migrations: NONE, open PRs against release: 0, config drift: none detected. Requesting interactive approvals: ops + product. React with :thumbsup: within 10m to approve expedited push.
tess: @oncall I'm +1 if rollback path is clear. Ops rollback plan: run rollback script or reimage nodes and revert tag. Please confirm exact rollback command in thread.
sasha: Rollback command (ops tested):
```
./scripts/rollback-embed.sh --cluster eu-west1 --tag v2.3.0 --grace-period 30
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.3.0
```
I tested rollback in staging and it works (reverts traffic and clears KV).
rohan: :thumbsup: (ops)
jamie: Product signoff from tess received in DM, posting here: tess: "prod impact > SLO, OK to expedite with rollback guardrails"
jamie: Approved. Triggering deploy now to Dedicated eu pool. Deploy ID: deploy_1729999999_hotpatch. Rolling 6 nodes, sequential.
deploybot: Deploy triggered by jamie. Canary bypass honored per expedited approval. Progress: 0/6 failed, 2/6 updated, 6/6 updated. Post-deploy smoke: PASS.
deploybot: Traffic shift: 100% moved to v2.3.1. Monitoring window 15m.
jamie: Monitor dashboards (embeds-errors, embed-latency, redis-ejects). If errors > 1% or 95th latency > 2x baseline, execute rollback command above and ping #incidents immediately.
sasha: Observability looks stable at +5m. No increase in error rate.
jamie: I'll update release notes and notify support to mark customer tickets that may be affected. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :rocket:
